questions.q: What does a Page Layout actually control, per this lesson?
options: Which fields, related lists, and buttons appear on a record's detail and edit page, and in what order
The actual values stored in a field
Which users are allowed to log into Salesforce
How a report calculates its totals
questions.explain: A Page Layout is purely a UI-level configuration of what appears on a record's page.

questions.q: Does a Page Layout affect whether a field holds data, per this lesson?
options: No — the Page Layout only controls what a user sees; it has no effect on the underlying data
Yes — removing a field from a Page Layout deletes its stored value
Yes — a field cannot be populated unless it's on the current Page Layout
Page Layouts and field data are the exact same thing
questions.explain: The lesson states explicitly that the Page Layout only controls visibility, not the underlying data.

questions.q: Do reports and SOQL queries pull from the Page Layout or from the underlying data model?
options: The underlying data model — a field left off a Page Layout still shows up in reports and queries
The Page Layout — fields not on the layout never appear in reports
Neither — reports use a separate, unrelated data source
Only fields visible to the report-runner's own Page Layout can appear
questions.explain: Reports and queries read directly from the data model, independent of any user's Page Layout.

questions.q: How does the Record Type concept from Lesson 18 connect to Page Layouts, per this lesson?
options: Different Page Layouts can be assigned to different Record Types, which is how each Record Type shows only its relevant fields
Record Types and Page Layouts are unrelated concepts that never interact
A Record Type replaces the need for a Page Layout entirely
Page Layouts can only be assigned to Profiles, never Record Types
questions.explain: The lesson explains that pairing different Page Layouts with different Record Types is exactly how the per-process field display works.

questions.q: A sales rep insists a field an analyst's report shows for their Opportunity 'doesn't exist.' What's the most likely explanation, per this lesson?
options: The field is real and holds data, but it isn't included on the Page Layout the rep is viewing
The analyst's report is definitely wrong and pulling fake data
The field was deleted from the object but still appears in old reports
The rep is looking at a completely different object
questions.explain: This is the exact scenario the lesson describes: a real field simply left off a particular Page Layout, not a broken report.
